scene sky
The air had changed in Kumon-mi lately.
Whoosh.
And it wasn’t just because there were arrows suddenly cutting through it.
It was because-
Whoosh.
It-
Whoosh.
Okay, we get it.
Anyway, if the sound effects or the mention of arrows didn’t do enough to inform you that today’s scene takes place at the archery range, allow the following CG to attempt to do the same.
scene utaioarcherytalk1

And if that still doesn’t do it for you, you should probably just exit the game now since your skills in both listening and reading comprehension make me seriously doubt your ability to understand anything at all.
If you’re still here, though, hello. I am too — serving as a celestial chaperone for two girls currently murdering a target with pointy sticks on a coldish but also slightly warm spring day.
If that one didn’t make any sense, it’s not your fault. But I digress and I return to what I said just moments ago about the air here changing.
Now that a celebrity had laid claim to the heart of Akira Arakawa, those still competing for a piece of it were doing all they could just to catch up.
For some, that meant fucking with their hair or their makeup or wardrobe.
But for others, it meant training to-
: Murder...
scene utaioarcherytalk2
: Are you going to say that every single time you shoot? Because, as an attorney, you should probably know that isn’t going to make your case easy to defend in court.
scene utaioarcherytalk3
: We do what we must do for love. Even if it means to kill.
scene utaioarcherytalk4
: See that target, Io? That target is pop music. And this arrow? This arrow is a career-ending scandal.
: You don’t have an arrow. You forgot to grab a new one.
: Shut up.

: Also, I’m not sure a “career ending scandal” is going to do much good at all when the girl you’re thinking about murdering sort of manufactured her own scandal. Let your arrows be apathy or something.
scene utaioarcherytalk5
: Ooh. That sounded kind of good. Maybe I can make Sensei like me more if I start writing poetry? I’m pretty sure that’s what Ami did.
: I just don’t get it, Io! Not even the top five have a shot now that Niki Nakayama is openly claiming him!
: We’re gonna need to do way more than just poetry or murder if we want a shot at catching up. We’re gonna need to do something crazy.
: Is murder not crazy anymore?
: Murder’s old news. I’m like one step away from taking Noriko up on her boombox idea.
: Hey, if you really want to earn some points, just jerk him off. That’s what I did and I think it went pretty well. I might have even jumped a spot or two in the rankings.
: Yes, well not everyone is-
scene utaioarcherytalk6
: Wait, you did what?!
: How’d your bow still make that noise without an arrow?
scene utaioarcherytalk7
: Io! You didn’t. You? The no-sex girl? You did hand-sex?!
: I guess. But if you ever want any chance of doing that as well, you probably shouldn’t call it “hand-sex.”
: I can’t believe you didn’t tell me! In vivid detail! How did you even bring yourself to do it with your whole “all sex is bad sex” mentality?
scene utaioarcherytalk8

: You probably want to keep your voice down when Miss Watabe is like, right there. Unless your goal is landing us in another support group which, not gonna lie, I don’t really have the time for anymore.
: Why? Cause you’re too busy with all the hot hand-sex you’re having and not telling me about?
: I don’t know. I just didn’t think it was a big deal.
scene utaioarcherytalk7
: Of course it’s a big deal! That’s a major step for you! You overcame a massive hurdle and you’re treating it like...well...like Sensei treats everything! Don’t become another him!
: Why? I thought you liked him.
: Yeah, but not all the sad parts!
: But those are like the only parts that exist in the first place.
: So?!
scene utaioarcherytalk9
: Uta, with all due respect, I’m a lot less inclined to do anything sexual if I need to report back to you afterward. And we both know how inclined I am to begin with, so yeah.
: I’m only probing you for answers because you brought it up! Which means that, deep down in your stupid Io-brain, there’s some sort of psychological compulsion to talk about it!
scene utaioarcherytalk10
: Oh, shit. You might be right.
: I am right! Which makes every second we spend here at murder practice one second we could be using for girl talk!
scene utaioarcherytalk11
: Ughh! But I hate girl talk! There’s so much girl involved!

: Miss Watabe! I need to go have my period in the tea ceremony room with Io! And you’re not legally allowed to ask any follow-up questions about that since it involves periods, I think! Can I have the key?!
scene utaioarcherytalk12
: No. Go have it somewhere that isn’t going to get blood all over our culture. And don’t drag Ichimonji into it either when we all know she hates anything even mildly related to girls.
: See? That’s how much I hate girl talk. I’ve barely even spoken to Miss Watabe and she knows.
: This time’s different! What if I promise not to bleed everywhere?! Can I have the key then?!
: If it gets you to shut up, fine. Take it. Tojo should have it. She was the last one to use the room.
scene black
: Tsuneyo!
: Welcome to Tojo Ramen. Please take your time looking over the menu and let me know-
: We’re at school, Kendo Princess.
: Oh, right. It appears that we are. Here is our takeout menu.
: You had that in your hakama?!
: I just want the key!
: And I’ll take the butter miso ramen with a side of a gyoza. Thanks.
: Eat later! Gossip now! Come, come, come!
scene utaioarcherytalk13
: Do we really need to sit like this? I hate seiza.
: I promised Miss Watabe I would respect our culture. And if we are going to be talking about handjobs in here, this is the only way I can currently think of that will do that.
: Fine. What do you want to know?
: Did you hate it? Do you intend to do it again?
: I did not hate it. But I could also live without ever doing it again and be totally fine.
scene utaioarcherytalk14
: How did it even happen? Like, did he come onto you or what?
: I am going to plead the fifth here because I don’t want to reveal any more than I already have and it is possible I have hidden even more things from you.
: As an attorney, I should inform you that pleading the fifth involves not incriminating yourself and you are already being investigated for aggravated hand-sex.
: Okay. But no one ever Mirandized me, so I think that must count for something.
: Is your name Miranda? I don’t think so. Speak, girl. How did it happen?
: Well...it kind of just did.
scene utaioarcherytalk15

: He came over to use the bath one day and I just reached around and stroked it while I was washing his back. It was surprisingly natural. And I’m not only saying that because of the years of sexual abuse.
: You bitch! I tried to do that once! That was supposed to be my move!
scene utaioarcherytalk16
: How did you even fail in the first place? Were your arms just not long enough or something?
scene utaioarcherytalk17
: I was interrupted by the ghosts of my past again and decided in that moment that it was more important to shield my naked youth from Sensei than it was to give him a handjob.
: Do I regret this decision? Yes. But that’s okay because I can now live vicariously through you who somehow had the strength to do what I did not against all odds.
: Or, you know, you could stop beating around the bush and just do it yourself already.
scene utaioarcherytalk18
: I want to, okay?! It’s just every time I feel like it’s about to happen, it doesn’t! And I don’t have the confidence to take the initiative like you apparently do!
: Oh, yay. I’m finally beating you at something. I just wish I wasn’t because that makes me sad.
scene utaioarcherytalk19
: So, like...can you tell me more? Maybe?
: More, like...like what? Do you want me to, like...make hand gestures or something? Because you'll need to get me a stuffed bear for that. The therapist always used a bear..
: You said you think doing that made Sensei like you more? Like you jumped in the rankings. Right? That’s what you said, isn’t it? How?
: I mean, I don’t know for sure. But we both know Sensei is a pervert and I am the complete opposite of that. So I think finally being able to do that for him can’t be a strike against me, right?
: You shouldn’t just do it for him, though! You need to want it yourself too or you’re just treating yourself like an object again! You’re not supposed to do that!
scene utaioarcherytalk20
: Well...that’s how it sounds, sure. But I actually did like it, I think. And it wasn’t really forcing myself either.
: I just felt like it was a good way for us to connect in that moment and I tried seeing it as an act of intimacy rather than...well, what it’s been every other time ever.
: It was...nice. He wasn’t weird about it. I wasn’t weird about it. And it didn’t keep me up that night. I got home, got dressed, took my meds, and went to bed like normal.
scene utaioarcherytalk21
: So, like...maybe I can-
scene utaioarcherytalk22
: You are crying.
: I am crying.
: Stop that.
: No.
: You are disrespecting our culture. We’re not supposed to show emotions in public.
scene utaioarcherytalk23
: I’m just proud of you, okay?! You had a super massive major moment behind the scenes and didn’t even tell me about it! I was worried this day wouldn’t ever come!
scene utaioarcherytalk24
: Let alone before it came for me! I’m the one who actually wants it! And when I say want it, Io, I mean badly!
: Yes, Uta. I am aware of how badly you want it. You make no effort to conceal that from me despite how you probably should.
: It’s mostly pride though, I swear! Furious jealousy is probably only, like...15%% of the tears!
scene utaioarcherytalk25
: You’re doing that to yourself, though, Uta.
: Like, you might think girls like the blonde one or the other blonde one who went black for a little but is now blonde again are your biggest obstacles. But the real obstacle is you, Uta.
: Please remember our classmates’ names. It’s been years, Io.
: You’re right. It has been years. Years of you wanting something and never taking it despite it being right there within your reach.
: I don’t like watching you suffer, Uta. But I like it even less when it’s a choice you’re actively making.
: Just...forget everyone else. Forget the nerves. Forget whatever it is that’s holding you back because, like it or not, you’re going to get left behind if you keep this up.
: Left behind?...
: What do you mean?...
scene utaioarcherytalk26
: When you moved here...and reinvented yourself...why did you do that?
: Because I...
: I wanted to start over. As someone completely new. Someone perfect and...and pure. The complete opposite of who I really am.
: You wanted to be someone who stands out, right?
scene utaioarcherytalk27
: And do you think you’re doing that now?
: Standing out?
: Or do you think, somewhere along the lines, it got harder playing pretend and you’ve settled back into what’s safe?
: I’m just scared, Io...
: Of what? You’re already in love and that’s the scariest thing of all.
: I know...I know. It’s just, like...
: Like, I don’t want this to sound like I don’t trust Sensei or that I think he’d, like...just use me or anything...but when I’ve taken initiative in the past, it’s...
: It’s only made things worse. So I...it’s just...harder to do that now, I think.
: Which, of course, just makes me spiral back into remembering how gross I am for putting myself out there the way I did and how nobody would want to be with me in the first place and-
: Stop that too. If I’m not allowed to call myself damaged goods despite actually being damaged goods, I’m not going to let some horny virgin steal all of my valor.
: I’m sorry, Io. Please don’t let me feeling sorry for myself take away from how proud I am of you.
: Oh, no. I implore you — please do take away from that. I hate being the center of attention and would much rather continue encouraging you to become wiener cousins with me.
: I think it’s “coochie cousins” when you’re talking about girls.
: Right, well I’m sure you understand why I didn’t say that.
: I think I’m just going to die a virgin. I’m not sure I even want to have sex anymore if Sensei’s going to compare me to fucking...Niki.
: You totally still want to have sex.
scene utaioarcherytalk28
: I want all the sex ever. I just always figured I’d be saying that in the missionary position rather than seiza.
: Wow, you really are a pervert if that’s the position that comes to mind. Deplorable. Disgraceful, even.
scene utaioarcherytalk29
: You said there was more you were hiding from me earlier.
: No I didn’t.
: What did you mean by that?
: I didn’t mean anything by it because I never said that. The hormones are just going to your head again.
: There is a history of that happening in this room for me. But still, I-
: Listen, Uta — I’ve already talked more openly about sex today than I have in a long time. And I’d like to call it quits here if that’s okay. But I will leave you with these parting words.
: I think you are currently on pace to be the last girl to ever have sex with Sensei. And, if that happens, I’m sorry, but I think I’ll just be too cool to be your friend at that point.
: Are you going to leave me if I don’t have sex with him?
: Yeah, I think you’re forcing my hand here.
scene utaioarcherytalk30
: Io!
: Now, if you’ll please excuse me, I’m going to go do something about all of the calluses on my hands so I can be better at hand-sex in the future. Good talk!
scene utaioarcherytalk31
: No! Bad talk! I didn’t get nearly enough detail about the actual handjob! All I got was pain and envy!
: Has the pride worn off then?
: Could your hand fit around the whole thing or was there still some real estate left?! Where in the bathhouse did it happen?! What were you wearing?!
: Do you think Tsuneyo’s still out there? I’m kind of hungry.
scene black
: This damn tea ceremony room is ruining my life!
: See you at the dorm, Uta! You clearly need some time to yourself!
: AAAAAAAAAHHHHHHHH!!!!!!!
The air had changed in Kumon-mi lately.
And, all around it, everything else was beginning to change too.
